title: STAT3 SH2 Domain Aspartic Acid 661 Mutations Activate Immune Gene Programs.
authors: Lee, Hye Kyung; Cho, Gyuhyeok; Chen, Jichun; Schultz, Aaron B; Lee, Sung-Gwon; Liu, Chengyu; Furth, Priscilla A; Young, Neal S; Kim, Jungwook; Villarino, Alejandro; Hennighausen, Lothar
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究STAT3 SH2域D661突变对免疫基因程序的激活，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（STAT3转录因子-DNA结合）和AlphaFold3结构预测，但核心是突变功能与免疫表型，而非TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法上AI结构预测仅作辅助，深度不足。
abstract: The conserved aspartic acid residue D661 within the STAT3 SH2 domain is a recurrent mutational hotspot in hematologic malignancies, including T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukaemia, myelodysplastic syndromes and acute lymphoblastic leukaemia. To define the functional consequences of distinct STAT3(D661) variants, we integrated computational, structural and in vitro and in vivo genetic approaches. AlphaMissense and PolyPhen-2 classified all four STAT3(D661) variants (D661Y, D661V, D661N and D661H) as pathogenic. ClinVar classified D661Y and D661V as variants of uncertain significance. AlphaFold 3-based modelling predicted that D661Y and D661V strongly promoted SH2-TAD-mediated dimerization, while D661N and D661H exerted weaker structural effects. Functional in vitro assays in Stat3-deficient T cells demonstrated a gain-of-function (GOF) hierarchy of the STAT3 variants (D661Y  approximately  V > H > N) resulting in activation of canonical STAT3 target genes and immune transcriptional programs. In vivo, only STAT3(D661H) mice were viable, displaying reduced CD4(+) T cells, expansion of memory CD8(+) T cells and enhanced immune gene expression. Collectively, our findings define a gradient of STAT3 D661 GOF variants, consistent with in vitro and in vivo experiments. D661Y and D661V mutants exhibited stronger transcriptional activity in T cells with impaired viability of mice carrying these variants.
abstract_zh: STAT3 SH2结构域内保守的天冬氨酸残基D661是血液系统恶性肿瘤（包括T细胞大颗粒淋巴细胞白血病、骨髓增生异常综合征和急性淋巴细胞白血病）中的复发性突变热点。为明确不同STAT3(D661)变异体的功能后果，我们整合了计算、结构以及体外和体内遗传学方法。AlphaMissense和PolyPhen-2将所有四种STAT3(D661)变异体（D661Y、D661V、D661N和D661H）分类为致病性。ClinVar将D661Y和D661V分类为意义未明的变异体。基于AlphaFold 3的建模预测，D661Y和D661V强烈促进SH2-TAD介导的二聚化，而D661N和D661H则产生较弱的结构效应。在Stat3缺陷T细胞中的功能性体外实验表明，STAT3变异体存在功能获得性（gain-of-function, GOF）层级（D661Y 约等于 V > H > N），导致经典STAT3靶基因和免疫转录程序被激活。在体内，仅STAT3(D661H)小鼠可存活，表现为CD4(+) T细胞减少、记忆性CD8(+) T细胞扩增以及免疫基因表达增强。总体而言，我们的研究结果定义了STAT3 D661 GOF变异体的梯度，与体外和体内实验一致。D661Y和D661V突变体在T细胞中表现出更强的转录活性，而携带这些变异体的小鼠生存能力受损。
